name: OS Client Certs -- cert9.db cleanup
description: TEST-BISECTION BUILD (v0.6.4.1): PROACTIVE-ONLY three-trigger architecture as in 0.6.4.0, next bisection step. 0.6.4.0 proved acquiring the nsIX509CertDB service alone does NOT break reading of incoming mail. 0.6.4.1 additionally calls certDB.getCerts() (the full PK11_ListCerts(PK11CertListUnique) enumeration incl. our osclientcerts token), logs the count, then returns [] immediately -- no email filter, no cert9.db read, no deleteCertificate. Purpose: isolate whether getCerts() alone (step 1 of doCleanup) corrupts later reading; if it doesn't break, the culprit must be in filter/SQL/delete. Same CA-excluding getEmailAddresses() logic as 0.6.3 remains but is unreachable in this build.
